collection: Employee leave policy allows employees to apply for annual leave through the HR portal. Leave requests must be approved by the reporting manager before they become effective.Employees are entitled to 20 days of paid annual leave every calendar year. Unused leave can be carried forward for up to 10 days.

Medical reimbursement covers consultation fees, diagnostic tests, prescribed medicines, and hospitalization expenses. Claims must be submitted within 30 days.Employees can reset their company password using the self-service password portal. A verification code will be sent to their registered mobile number.
VPN access is mandatory for employees working remotely. Employees must authenticate using multi-factor authentication before connecting.

Travel reimbursement includes airfare, hotel accommodation, local transportation, and meal expenses. Original bills are required for reimbursement.The company provides health insurance for employees and their dependents. Coverage includes inpatient, outpatient, and emergency medical services.

The office working hours are from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday through Friday. Flexible working hours are available with manager approval.Performance reviews are conducted twice a year. Employees receive ratings based on goals, technical skills, communication, and teamwork.

Employees should report IT incidents through the Service Desk portal. Critical incidents receive priority response within one hour.Laptop replacement is available every four years or in case of hardware failure approved by the IT department.
Employees can access training courses through the Learning Management System (LMS). Course completion certificates are automatically generated.
New employees must complete mandatory onboarding training within their first 30 days.
Expense claims exceeding $500 require department head approval.
Employees should change their passwords every 90 days to comply with security policies.
The company observes 12 public holidays each year. Holiday schedules are published on the HR portal.
Business travel requires prior approval from the reporting manager and finance department.
Meeting rooms can be booked using the Office Reservation System.
Employees can request work-from-home approval through the HR portal.
Resignation requires a minimum notice period of 30 days unless otherwise specified in the employment contract.
